role: Implements guilt relief mechanisms through acknowledgment detection and behavioral-change tracking per CANON §A.14.
detail: Exports GuiltyRepair class that computes guilt relief based on action outcomes. Detects acknowledgment via keyword matching (apologize, acknowledge, accept, responsibility, admit, regret, sorry); detects behavioral change by comparing current action type to previous error action type. Relief schedule: acknowledgment only -0.10, behavioral change only -0.15, both -0.30. Maintains in-memory error history (max 10 entries, 15-min timeout) to track recent errors. Provides singleton instance via getOrCreateGuiltyRepair(). Also exports GuiltRepairEffect interface for drive effect mapping.
gotchas: No external persistence — error history lost on process restart; behavioral-change detection simple string equality (could miss semantic equivalence); no validation that previousErrorActionType is actually recent (relies on caller passing correct context)
